chapter: Buddy Petit's death, Milneburg and halls
title: Milneburg Sundays and heavy sticks
summary: Penn and Manuel Paul recall many bands playing pavilions at Milneburg and using heavy sticks to be heard.

story.theme_name: Dance halls, lake camps and riverboat bandstands
story.community_name: Dance halls, lake resorts and where bands played

blocks.x: What about those Milenburg things? Were they good fun?

Well it was a lot of fun because they used to have so many bands out there on Sunday till you just get up and walk to the gallery and just listen to another band playing they could do it to you. And both bands was fighting hard you know. It was very fun. Yes it was fun. Did you use the heavy sticks on those? Oh yeah you had to because they had so many bands around you know. You wanted to be heard you know. When you were bucking you used the heavy sticks?
Oh yeah I grabbed the heavy sticks.
Did you take them both with you on the job like that?
Oh yeah. I used to have them.

That was fun those days when Milenburg was running because you'd go out on a Sunday evening and you'd just know you were going to be around three and four bands out there playing different pavilions. There was a lot of kicks. And that music sounds so good going on the water you know. It sounds good. I used to be out there.
